# ColorRoll

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public record ColorRoll
```

The resolved color of one layer, for the rich nfty metadata. Represents every kind: Dynamic and Static carry (Model, H, S); Custom carries none (all null, composited as-is).
